It builds on useErrorText (common.errors / network error) and adds account-specific mappings: ReauthCancelled, NotAllowedError/InvalidStateError, and RATE_LIMITED/REAUTH_RATE_LIMITED/KYC_RATE_LIMITED mapped to account.errors.codes.*. Raw messages from client-side (non-API) errors are never shown. Server messages, which exist only in Turkish, are shown only when locale=tr; other locales get the caller's translated fallback. errorMessage/err.message usage was removed from AgentMandates, IdentityVerification and PrivacyCenter. ReauthCancelledError no longer carries a user-facing message. Not done: the ui.tsx errorMessage default and the api-client 'İstek başarısız' message belong to other owners (crossOwner).

SessionManager and PasskeyManager now use useAccountErrorText instead of err.message/passkeyErrorMessage. In ReauthDialog, WebAuthn errors map to t('passkeys.cancelled'/'alreadyRegistered'), UNAUTHORIZED maps to t('reauth.wrongPassword') for password attempts and t('failed') for passkey, and network errors map to common.errors.network. 'Failed to fetch' and Turkish server text no longer reach the EN interface.

SessionManager: closing the 'This device' session no longer calls DELETE+reauth. After confirmation it calls logout() directly (which closes the current session on the server) and goes to /login. AgentMandates amount field: type=text inputMode=decimal autoComplete=off, controlled. min/step removed (this also removes the mouse-wheel issue). Focus moves to the field on error. Added an example format in the hint (amountHint) and a live preview below the field with aria-live=polite, formatted with f.money ('Limit: ₺1.500,00'). The currency select is controlled so the preview uses the right currency. toMinor/float rounding removed. The currency adornment was skipped (visual/layout change).

AgentMandates revoke now asks first through useConfirm (tone=danger, initial focus on Cancel). The body states the amount limit, the expiry date and that the action cannot be undone. During the request the button gets busy={revoking===nonce}, which prevents double submission. The button has min-h-[44px] on mobile. Errors are shown with errorText(…, revokeFailed).

PrivacyCenter: for ApiError ACCOUNT_HAS_OBLIGATIONS, err.details (hostedBookings/pendingPayouts/openClaims) is read and shown inside the delete card as a list with counts and links (/host, /host/payouts, /resolution). The delete error moved from the top of the page into the card (Status). Other errors are localized. Showing the obligations before confirmation and reauth needs a pre-check endpoint (backend), so it was not done.

and a 44px 'Try again' link to '/' with an inline focus ring, and the search form stays usable. error.tsx and global-error.tsx were already handled globally.

On success the form is reset with form.reset() and the preview is cleared. Not done: the host name is not in the public API response, and the server-side idempotency key needs a backend change.

NoticeForm: details.fieldErrors from the 400 response is mapped to per-field i18n messages (errors.*) and passed to Field's error prop, so aria-invalid and aria-describedby are set. The first invalid field gets focus. Client side, the explanation is checked with trim().length>=20 and the email with a regex that requires a TLD before sending. Each error clears once the user fixes it while typing. The button uses busy instead of disabled, so focus is not lost.

NoticeForm sent state: the Card and an aria-live region stay mounted the whole time, and only their content changes. An h2 'Bildiriminiz alındı' (tabIndex=-1, scroll-mt-24) and the reference message are shown. A useEffect calls scrollIntoView({block:'start'}) and then focus().
Page titles are handled globally (wave 1). Per the task instruction I added no title or metadata, so trust/page.tsx and admin/compliance/page.tsx were not changed.

AppealForm: when the reason is shorter than 20 characters, focus moves to #appeal-reason, so the label, aria-invalid and the error text are read together. The textarea onChange clears the error once the trimmed length reaches 20. No role=alert was added (it was unnecessary). The button uses busy instead of disabled, and a guard blocks double submits.

Notices, appeals and the accessibility queue: each item has an h3 with tabIndex=-1 (notice-/appeal-/a11y-{id}-title). Before an action, the neighbouring item (next, or previous if there is none) is stored. After reload, a useEffect moves focus to that item's heading, or to the Card heading ({id}-title, tabindex=-1 added) when the list is empty. When a takedown is closed, focus goes to that row's status text (td-{id}-state).

Each action now has its own pending state and a pendingRef guard. While a request runs, the related Button gets busy (aria-disabled + aria-busy) and the label 'Kaydediliyor…'; a second submit or click is ignored. This covers takedown create and close, notice decisions, appeal decisions, and verify/unverify. Not done: the takedown POST would need an Idempotency-Key, but the route does not support one, so that part needs a backend/API change.

The global Status at the top was removed. Action errors now appear in a Status right under each item's or form's submit button. Success messages show next to the takedown form or row, and in the card's Status when the item drops out of the list. Load errors appear inside the related card with a 'Tekrar dene' (reload) button. The three error sources are no longer merged into one string.

The listing ID field now has autoComplete=off, spellCheck=false, a hint, a title/city preview on blur, and a 'İlan hemen yayından kaldırılsın mı?' danger confirmation before submit, so Enter also goes through the confirmation. Not done: a full listing-search combobox needs an admin listing-search API, which needs a backend change.

'Kapat' now opens an inline form in the row instead of closing straight away. It has a required 'Kapatma gerekçesi' textarea (minLength 3, maxLength 2000) with a feedforward hint saying the request cannot be reopened and the host may republish the listing, plus 'Talebi kapat' (danger, busy) and 'Vazgeç' buttons. The resolution value comes from this field; t('defaultResolution') is no longer used.

Notices and takedowns now have separate loading, error and empty states: role=status common.loading while loading, an error plus 'Tekrar dene' on failure, and 'Bekleyen bildirim yok' / 'Kayıtlı talep yok' only when data is an empty array. AppealQueue and AccessibilityReviewQueue also got a loading state.

Added break-all to the notice content URL, min-w-0 to its container, and break-words to the explanation paragraph. Long text in the appeal reason, takedown rows and accessibility notes also got break-words. No colors were changed.

The decision select is now controlled and required, and starts on an empty disabled 'Seçin…' option. The ground select is only rendered when decision === REMOVED, also with an empty default and required. In AppealQueue no radio is pre-selected: required, a 'Bir sonuç seçin.' hint linked with aria-describedby, and if nothing is chosen an item-level error is shown and focus goes to the first radio. The ground select there also starts empty and is required. The radio labels are min-h-[44px] on mobile.

NoticeForm and AppealForm: the Card and its aria-live container stay mounted in every state, and only the content changes, so the message is announced. A focusable heading (h2 sentTitle / h3 sentTitle) is focused and scrolled into view in a useEffect.
